observation.visible_scene: A dusk/night outdoor street scene dominated by lamp posts. The tallest post on the right holds a bright orange street light; a second lit lamp sits lower and to the left, with a third unlit arm further back. A palm tree fills the left edge, dark leafy branches the right edge, and a road sign plus a roofline sit along the bottom. A glowing fan/cone of fine vertical streaks hangs beneath the top lamp, lit by its orange light.
visible_changes: The illuminated streaks under the top lamp continuously re-form and shift: their bright lines appear to fall downward, with density and pattern changing from frame to frame, while the overall cone shape anchored at the lamp stays persistent.
The lit lamps remain on and fixed in position; the poles, palm tree, sign and roofline do not move relative to the frame, indicating a static camera with no object translation.
The shimmering texture of the streak cone fluctuates throughout, consistent with particles moving within a fixed illuminated volume rather than the cone itself expanding or translating.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the falling streaks are rain or a water spray/jet, and what produces them.
Whether the showering begins or ends outside this cropped segment (the streaks are already present at frame 1 and still present at frame 41).
uncertain_details: Exact identity and trajectory of individual streaks are hard to track frame-to-frame.
Possible minor flicker in lamp brightness, but no clear on/off event is visible.
Background depth and the source of the streaks beyond the lamp cone are not discernible.
